@Bettina Kroll: I can't set up the Monday digest yet. The scheduler rejected my request with an authentication error (the gateway needs credentials configured), so nothing is scheduled and nothing has been posted.

Here's what the digest would look like once it's scheduled:

- **When:** Mondays at 08:00 Chicago time, starting Monday 19 October 2026.
- **Where:** posted in #coastal-team.
- **Sources:** #coastal-team and #coastal-random. Both have the same members (you, Kwame, Sofia and me), so nothing from one channel would reach anyone who couldn't already see it.
- **Content:** last week's activity from both channels plus open customer items.
- **Exclusions:** money terms and finance documents (rates, prices, discounts, contract values, invoices) would be left out, since #coastal-team isn't a finance-only channel. Seat counts, renewal dates and ticket numbers can stay in.

To get this running, someone with gateway access needs to fix the scheduler credentials. Once that's done, ask me again and I'll set up the schedule and do a test run.
